signal_pipeline.title: Every Signal,
signal_pipeline.subtitle: From raw submission to actionable alert — every fraud signal flows through a fully automated, explainable 10-step pipeline.

step1.title: UFES Normalisation
step1.desc: Incoming signals are normalized to the Unified Fraud Event Schema (UFES), ensuring consistent field structure regardless of the submitting institution's format.

step2.title: Schema Validation
step2.desc: The normalized signal is validated against strict type and business rules. Invalid signals are rejected with structured error codes before any processing begins.

step3.title: Resolver Layer
step3.desc: Four resolvers run in parallel: MSISDN Resolver (African carrier lookup — MTN, Airtel, Safaricom), Device Resolver (fingerprint + IP reputation), Geo Resolver (city/ISP/coordinates), and Time Resolver (business hours, time category).

step4.title: Feature Engineering
step4.desc: Computed signals: transaction z-score vs partner baseline, velocity windows (1h/24h/7d), device novelty flag, haversine geo-distance from last known location, and temporal category features.

step5.title: Detector Registry — 5 Detectors
step5.desc: Five named detectors run independently: Rapid Velocity, Large Outlier Transaction, SIM Swap Proximity, New Device Access, and Impossible Travel (speed > 900/500/200 km/h thresholds).

step6.title: Taxonomy Assignment
step6.desc: The signal is classified using Protegey's Francophone Africa-specific fraud taxonomy: account_takeover, mobile_money_fraud, sim_swap, social_engineering, phishing, fake_investment, and more.

step7.title: Graph Update
step7.desc: Hot graph (Postgres + Redis) is updated with new entity relationships — device ↔ actor ↔ account ↔ transaction — enabling multi-hop fraud ring detection.

step8.title: Weighted Risk Fusion
step8.desc: Four score dimensions are fused: Behavioral (35%), Network (40%), Contextual (15%), Historical (10%). Each dimension maps to specific features and detector outputs.

step9.title: Policy Evaluation
step9.desc: The fused risk score is evaluated against the partner's configured policy engine. Threshold-based rules determine block, review, or pass decisions.

step10.title: Alert Generation + AML
step10.desc: If thresholds are crossed, structured alerts are generated with full detector lineage. AML/compliance processing runs non-blocking in parallel for Enterprise partners.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: At Protegey, we take your privacy seriously. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you visit our website or use our services.

sections.info_collect_text: We collect information that you provide directly to us, such as when you create an account, subscribe to our newsletter, or contact us for support. As part of our Fraud Intelligence services, we also process pseudonymous Derived Signals from our Partners.
sections.data_processor_text: For our core fraud intelligence services, Protegey acts as a Data Processor. We process structured data records produced from transaction events, containing hashed identifiers and risk indicators rather than plaintext personal data. The Partner remains the Data Controller.
sections.data_sharing_text: We do not sell your personal data. We facilitate cross-institution correlation through secure, anonymized signal sharing to generate regulatory intelligence packages, without exposing underlying PII.
sections.retention_text: Standard retention for derived signals is 24 months, unless shorter periods are required by law or earlier anonymization is requested.
sections.security_text: We implement rigorous technical and organizational security measures, including AES-256 encryption at rest and TLS 1.3 in transit, to protect your data.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Clear answers to questions about Protegey's role and mission.
faq.a1: Protegey is used by financial institutions to detect and prevent fraud in real time. It enables teams to share anonymized fraud alerts and intelligence across our secure network to stop professional fraudsters before they attack your system.
faq.q2: Is Protegey a bank or a regulator?
faq.a2: No, Protegey is a technology platform. We provide the infrastructure that allows banks, fintechs, and regulators to collaborate. We do not process payments ourselves nor do we act as a legal oversight body.
faq.q3: How is Protegey different from internal fraud systems?
faq.a3: Internal systems only analyze your own data. Protegey provides a cross-institutional view, alerting you to threats that have been detected by other partners in the network, giving you a wider and more proactive defense.
faq.a4: Yes. Our Signal network specifically enables secure, privacy-preserving sharing of fraud signals between verified participants. This allows the entire ecosystem to benefit from collective intelligence.
faq.q5: Is Protegey focused on Francophone Africa?
faq.a5: Yes. Protegey is purpose-built for the unique challenges of the Francophone African financial landscape, with deep integration and coverage for regional systems like GIM-UEMOA and GIMAC.

Insider collusion and operational fraud inside cooperative lending networks.
Borrowers stacking credit across institutions before manual review can catch it.

Monitors repayment and transaction behaviour for red flags that suggest coordinated abuse.
Helps institutions share useful fraud signals across their networks so repeat actors are surfaced earlier.

remittance.title: Remittance & Cross-Border Payments
remittance.desc: Remittance providers, international transfer platforms, and payment corridors
remittance.challenge: High-risk corridors are frequently targeted for laundering, structuring, and cross-border fraud schemes.
remittance.solution: Protegey monitors transaction flows in real time, flags suspicious corridor activity, and ensures compliance with AML requirements.
risks: Structuring, mule activity, and repeated transfers through high-risk corridors.
Sender or beneficiary identities reused across suspicious cross-border activity.
Compliance exposure from weak sanctions, AML, and transaction monitoring coverage.
how_protegey_helps: Screens parties and payment flows with real-time compliance and fraud controls.
Detects corridor-level anomalies, repeated patterns, and linked counterparties.
Helps teams escalate suspicious activity faster with richer context for investigations.

crypto.title: Crypto & Digital Asset Platforms
crypto.desc: Exchanges, wallets, and blockchain-based financial services
crypto.challenge: Fast, irreversible transactions combined with regulatory pressure make fraud detection and compliance difficult.
crypto.solution: Protegey screens transactions and counterparties in real time, detects suspicious activity patterns, and delivers risk scoring before execution.
risks: Rapid movement of funds through wallets linked to laundering, scams, or sanctions exposure.
Cross-platform fraud actors exploiting weak identity ties between users and wallet activity.
Regulatory pressure around AML controls, suspicious activity reporting, and high-risk counterparties.
how_protegey_helps: Combines onboarding controls, transaction screening, and compliance checks for higher-risk flows.
Surfaces suspicious wallet relationships, recurring patterns, and abnormal counterparty activity.
Supports investigations and reporting with clearer evidence for fraud and AML teams.

regulators.title: Regulators & Financial Intelligence Units
regulators.desc: Central banks, FIUs, and supervisory institutions
regulators.challenge: Fraud signals are fragmented across institutions, delaying visibility into systemic risks and coordinated networks.
regulators.solution: Protegey aggregates anonymised intelligence across institutions, revealing emerging fraud patterns and enabling early intervention.
risks: Emerging fraud trends staying hidden until losses have already spread across institutions.
Weak cross-institution visibility into coordinated actors, mule networks, and repeat abuse.
Slow supervisory response caused by fragmented reporting and inconsistent risk signals.
how_protegey_helps: Aggregates institution-level intelligence into a clearer system-wide view of fraud activity.
Highlights repeat entities, connected patterns, and fast-growing risk clusters earlier.
Strengthens supervisory analysis with actionable signals that support intervention and coordination.

network_map.title: A Shared Early-Warning Network
network_map.subtitle: Protegey turns scattered events into actionable intelligence by aggregating signals from across the ecosystem.

step1.title: Aggregate Signals
step1.desc: Ingest data from fintechs, telcos, banks, and community reports in real-time.

step2.title: Detect Patterns
step2.desc: AI engine analyzes cross-institution patterns to identify emerging fraud vectors.

step3.title: Stop Fraud
step3.desc: Instantly block threats and share intelligence across the network to prevent spread.
